library(plotly)
log_info('Inside contrast visual  ....')

label_work <- gsub('Group','',label)
  label_work_f <- gsub(' ','_',label_work)

log_info('  Vocano plot ....')

data$volcano
ggsave(file.path(path,paste0("Volcano_annotated",".pdf")) , plot=data$volcano2file , dpi = 600, height = 6, width = 10 )
library(DT)
log_info('  Top table rendering ....')

## filter only selected  

table2viz <- data$toptable %>% select( precursor.Id, logFC, pval, adjPval,Protein.Group,Accession, Genes, pep_type, total_repeats, start , end , significance, interest )

DT::datatable( table2viz %>% arrange(adjPval)  ,
             extensions = c('FixedColumns', 'Scroller'),
             options = list(fixedColumns = TRUE, scrollY = 400, scrollX = TRUE,
                            scroller = TRUE, dom = 'Bfrtip', autoWidth = TRUE
             ),
 ) %>%  formatRound(columns=c('logFC'), digits=2) %>%
  formatSignif(columns = c('pval', 'adjPval'), digits = 2) 

ttable <- data$toptable %>% arrange(adjPval) 
write.csv2(ttable, file= file.path(path,paste0("Toptable",".csv")), row.names=FALSE )
log_info('  Barcode plot rendering ....')

#plotly_barcode <- lapply(data$barcode_plty, function(p) if (!is.null(p)) ggplotly(p))

htmltools::tagList(data$barcode_plty)
log_info('  Barcode plot saving as pdf ....')
log_info(paste(  data$POI, collapse= ' '))

log_info(paste( names(data$barcode_gg), collapse= ' '))

for (a in names(data$barcode_gg)) {
    log_info(a)
   tryCatch({
   ggsave(file.path(path,paste0("Barcode_",a,".pdf")) , plot=data$barcode_gg[[a]] , dpi = 600, height = 6, width = 6 )
 message("Saved: ", file.path(path,paste0("Barcode_",a,".pdf")))
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning(sprintf("Failed to save %s: %s", paste0("Barcode_",a,".pdf") , e$message))
    })
}
